how: Graph Explorer, signed in as a test-tenant user, Microsoft Graph v1.0. Requests as listed in ../README.md.

messages.role: sent, Purview label 'Confidential Encrypted' plus legacy 1 / 2 / 3

searchWithoutInternetMessageHeaders.result: the $expand filter is ignored: returns 'Binary 0xf03' and the normalized subject instead of the requested properties. Mailbox-wide and folder-scoped alike, with or without ConsistencyLevel: eventual.

searchWithInternetMessageHeadersSelected.result: both properties returned in full (Purview 436/441 characters), mailbox-wide and folder-scoped, Inbox and Sent Items, alone or inside a $batch

searchNextLink.result: the @odata.nextLink keeps $select and $expand; page 2 returns both properties in full

listFolderWithExpand.result: without internetMessageHeaders in $select the Purview value is cut to its first 255 characters (label id kept, _Name lost); with it, full

filterLegacyCast.url: $filter=singleValueExtendedProperties/any(ep: ep/id eq 'Integer 0x0036' and cast(ep/value, Edm.Int32) ne 0)

searchPlusFilter.error: SearchWithFilter: The query parameter '$filter' is not supported with '$search'.

notProbed: a saved draft carrying a Purview label (none in the mailbox); sent items are former drafts and carry it
why selecting internetMessageHeaders changes what $search returns; it is not documented
